hero.title: LEARN. BUILD. SHARE.
hero.subtitle: JUSTCODE-KL is the leading student computer science community at RPTU Kaiserslautern. We help students learn through practical projects, share their knowledge, and prepare for successful tech careers.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.vision_desc: Build a thriving tech community where students grow through hands-on learning, develop innovative projects, and empower each other to succeed.
mission.mission_desc: Provide students with a platform to learn through real projects, exchange knowledge, and develop valuable skills for their professional careers.
mission.values_desc: Just Code, Just Connect, Just KL, Collaboration, Innovation, Excellence, Knowledge Sharing, and an open, international tech community.
